name: screenshot
description: Capture a screenshot and extract text via OCR. Supports wlroots compositors (niri/hyprland/sway), KDE Plasma, GNOME/Cinnamon, and X11 sessions. Use when the user asks about errors, code, terminal output, or anything visible on their screen.

region.description: Which area to capture: 'focused' (default) captures the active window, falling back to the active or default screen; 'screen' captures the active display
